title: Salmon With Creamed Spinach & Parmesan Sauce
description: From Tieghan Gerard of Half Baked Harvest Quick & Cozy cookbook: This one-skillet Creamy Garlic Butter Baked Salmon is for those nights when you’re craving something a little fancier but need something quick and easy to prepare. The salmon is mixed into a simple parmesan cream sauce with spinach, lemon, and fresh herbs. This salmon is easy and delicious, plus wonderful for all seasons. And the best part is that it comes together in less than an hour!
ingredients: 4 salmon filets, skin on or off (your preference)
¼ cup loosely packed fresh basil leaves, chopped
1 tablespoon lemon juice, plus the zest of 1 lemon
directions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees. Season the salmon with salt and pepper, then set aside.

In an oven-safe skillet, add 2 tablespoons olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter, the shallot, thyme, and garlic; cook stirring often until softened, about 2 minutes. Season to taste with crushed red pepper.
Reduce heat to medium and stir in cream and mustard. Bring to a low simmer over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens slightly, 1 to 2 minutes.
Add the spinach and Parmesan with a little salt and pepper; cook until the spinach is wilted, 1 to 2 minutes.
Remove pan from heat and slide in the salmon. Top with remaining butter.
Bake in preheated oven until salmon is warm in the center and turning opaques, about 8 minutes or longer to your liking.
Broil until the top is browned in spots, 1 to 2 minutes.
While salmon cooks, toss basil, parsley, lemon zest, and juice in a small bowl.
Spoon cream sauce of salmon, then top with herb mixture, and maybe a little flaky salt.
